title: cynosurus cristatus subsp. polybracteatus
intro: Cynosurus cristatus subsp. polybracteatus, commonly known as Hardy Cynosure, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including the ability to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hardy Cynosure include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, reducing inflammation and relaxing the airways, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
